notes:
- Aspect ratios: formats that can be more than one shape now have a ratio pill under them in “Which short-form formats?”. Pick 9:16, 4:3, 1:1 or 16:9; picking one also picks the format.
- Letterbox, Headline and Wraparound start at 16:9, Cinema Box at 4:3, B-roll at 4:3, the rest at 9:16. Hook Box, Split screen and Documentary stay 9:16.
- B-Roll Story is replaced by B-roll (was Horizontal B-roll). Margin Vertical is now Margin at 9:16.
